related_questions.question: How do you treat an asthma cough?

text_blocks.snippet: There isn't a single "cure" for asthma cough, but it can be effectively managed with a combination of medications and lifestyle adjustments. Treatment focuses on controlling inflammation, relaxing airway muscles, and avoiding triggers.
snippet_highlighted_words: There isn't a single "cure" for asthma cough

list.title: Inhaled corticosteroids:
list.snippet: These are the most common controller medications for asthma, helping to reduce inflammation in the airways.

list.title: Quick-relief inhalers (e.g., albuterol):
list.snippet: These bronchodilators relax the muscles around the airways, providing quick relief from symptoms like coughing and wheezing.

list.title: Long-acting beta-agonists (LABAs):
list.snippet: These are controller medications that help keep airways open for longer periods, often used in combination with inhaled corticosteroids.

list.title: Biologics:
list.snippet: For severe asthma that is not well-controlled by other medications, biologics may be an option. They work by targeting specific parts of the immune system to reduce inflammation.
Identify and avoid triggers: Common triggers include allergens (pollen, dust mites, pet dander), irritants (smoke, pollution), and exercise.
Maintain a healthy weight: Obesity can worsen asthma symptoms.
Manage stress: Stress can trigger asthma attacks.
Consider diet: Some individuals may find that certain foods trigger or worsen their asthma symptoms.
Quit smoking: Smoking significantly exacerbates asthma.
Acupuncture: Some studies suggest acupuncture may help manage asthma symptoms and improve lung function.
Honey: Honey can help loosen mucus and may provide some relief from cough.

list.title: Consult a doctor:
list.snippet: It's crucial to work with a healthcare professional to develop a personalized asthma management plan.

list.title: Don't substitute medications:
list.snippet: Do not use caffeine or other remedies in place of prescribed asthma medications.

list.title: Follow instructions:
list.snippet: Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor for taking your medications and managing your condition.
